"''Send them in.''|Dar Wac announces the arrival of Supi and the committee to Palpatine|quotestart=0|italics=0|audio=DarWac-AOTC.flac|}} '''Supi''' was a [[Color|green]]-skinned [[Twi'lek]] who served the corrupt [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]] as a loyal [[aide]]. Supi had a bitter rivalry with another of Taa's aides named [[Pampy]], and the two fiercely competed for his favor. In [[22 BBY]], Supi accompanied Taa and other members of the [[Galactic Senate]]'s [[Loyalist Committee]] to a meeting in the [[Emperor's office|office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. ==Biography== Supi was a [[Twi'lek]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]],''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' the corrupt representative of the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}} During the [[Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]]. Taa served as a member of the [[Loyalist Committee]], and Supi accompanied him and [[Pampy]], another of his aides, along with the other members of the committee, to a meeting in the [[Emperor's office|office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] in the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]]. [[File:Supi-LoyalistCommittee-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Supi (center) visited Palpatine's office with the Loyalist Committee.]] Upon the committee's arrival, Palpatine's assistant [[Dar Wac]] let the [[chancellor]] know that Supi and the others had arrived. Palpatine then had Wac send them into the office just as he concluded a meeting with the members of the [[Jedi High Council]]. Before the committee sat down, the two groups discussed the recent [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempts]] on the life of Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], another member of the Loyalist Committee. The [[Jedi]] then left after agreeing to provide additional protection to Amidala, leaving the committee to begin its meeting with Palpatine. ==Personality and traits== Supi was loyal to Orn Free Taa and competed fiercely for his favor with Pampy, with whom Supi had a bitter rivalry; however, Taa was unsatisfied with any companion who was not a red-skinned Twi'lek [[Gender|female]]. Supi had [[Color|green]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== During the meeting in Palpatine's office, Supi wore a maroon [[robe]] with a gray and maroon [[Clothing|gown]] over it as well as a silver headpiece. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:SupiPampy-ImageAttack.png|thumb|right|250px|The extra portraying Supi wore mitts between takes.]] Supi first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' While filming, the extras portraying Supi and Pampy wore mitts between scenes in order to avoid spreading their makeup around.{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/01/imageattack20030123.html|series=Image Attack|text=Colorful Assistants}} In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind", which was written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]].{{SW|url=news/die-wanna-wanga-encounters-of-the-twilek-kind|text=Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind|nolive=1}} The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where [[Supi/Legends|Supi]] was revealed prior to the release of the film in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and released on [[April 23]],
